title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin holds 62,500 after a 0.9 percent dip as Fear and Greed sinks to 22 in extreme fear territory. Hashrate remains firm at 923.8 EH/s, showing miners are not blinking. Mempool sits heavy at 96,746 transactions, yet fees stay cheap at 2 sat/vB.

Watch Asia flows into the European open for any volume surge that could test the 62k level again. Block 957,985 just locked in.
